_comment: Core roundtable pubkeys. Comments from these npubs show in the default
'Roundtable only' view. Everyone else shows only when a reader switches
the toggle to 'Everyone'. This filters what the page displays. It does
not delete or block anything on the relays.
Fill the npub field for each person from a source you trust directly,
such as their own post or a key they gave you. Do not copy an npub from
a search result. A wrong npub gives an impersonator roundtable weight.
Entries with an empty npub are ignored by the filter.
